## Hannah Arendt quote sources

10 passages attributed to Hannah Arendt in this archive, each with the locator that lets you find it in the work itself — and the one thing that most often goes wrong when people quote Arendt.

[Quote source](https://www.philosophydef.com/quote-source) / Hannah Arendt

How to cite this author, and what circulates under the name that is not theirs to give.

### Sourcing profile

Language of the works

English and German

Cited here from

The Human Condition, The Life of the Mind, Men in Dark Times, Eichmann in Jerusalem, and On Violence.

How to cite it

Chapter and section, plus the book's year. Arendt's books have been reissued in several paperback impressions with different pagination while keeping the same text, so a page number is the weakest possible locator for her.

Where quotations of this author go wrong

Arendt wrote her later books in English and then reworked them in German, so two authorised versions exist and they are not always equivalent. She also wrote in long, deliberately qualified sentences; a quotation pulled from the middle of one and presented as a standalone assertion usually reverses the emphasis she built up to it.

### Frequently asked questions

#### Where can I check quotations attributed to Hannah Arendt?

Chapter and section, plus the book's year. Arendt's books have been reissued in several paperback impressions with different pagination while keeping the same text, so a page number is the weakest possible locator for her. This archive cites Hannah Arendt from The Human Condition, The Life of the Mind, Men in Dark Times, Eichmann in Jerusalem, and On Violence. Every passage listed on this page carries that locator, so it can be found in any edition of the work.

#### What is the most common mistake when quoting Hannah Arendt?

Arendt wrote her later books in English and then reworked them in German, so two authorised versions exist and they are not always equivalent. She also wrote in long, deliberately qualified sentences; a quotation pulled from the middle of one and presented as a standalone assertion usually reverses the emphasis she built up to it.

#### What language did Hannah Arendt write in?

English and German. For an author writing in English the wording is settled at source, but editions and titles are not — see the citation note above.
